name: expiredPackageLicensesCount
definition: The number of installed application package licences in the connected org whose status is Expired.
population: the PackageLicense records of the connected Salesforce org
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete query result of the org's PackageLicense records (done, every record read); the count of Expired is then exact, and an org with no package licence reads 0. An error or refused answer, a partial read, or any missing status is not measured (a count beside one is only a lower bound).

changeLog.change: Registered so the Salesforce transform can emit it.

notes: Registered so the transform named in citations can emit it. Other vendors that use the same name were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.
